items.source: Couchbase transaction status for Spring Data transaction framework.
items.translation: Spring Data 事务框架中的 Couchbase 事务状态。

items.source: transaction - underlying transaction object that can hold state for the internal transaction implementation
items.translation: transaction - 底层事务对象，可用于存储内部事务实现的状态信息。

items.source: newTransaction - if the transaction is new, otherwise participating in an existing transaction
items.translation: newTransaction - 如果是新事务，否则表示参与现有事务

items.source: newSynchronization - if a new transaction synchronization has been opened for the given transaction
items.translation: newSynchronization - 如果已为该事务打开新的事务同步

items.source: readOnly - whether the transaction is marked as read-only
items.translation: readOnly - 是否将事务标记为只读

items.source: debug - should debug logging be enabled for the handling of this transaction? Caching it in here can prevent repeated calls to ask the logging system whether debug logging should be enabled.
items.translation: debug - 是否应为此事务的处理启用调试日志？在此处缓存该设置可避免重复调用日志系统以查询调试日志是否已启用。

items.source: suspendedResources - a holder for resources that have been suspended
items.translation: <suspendedResources> - 用于存放已挂起资源的容器
